😀. He walked. She was walking. She kicked the bucket.
The old lamp glowed. The old lamp broke. The old lamp faded.
She waited. She listened. She watched. She left.
“Stop,” she pleaded softly. “Go,” he said.
“Fine.” She smiled.
“Go.” She set down the cup. “Now.”


“A.”
“B.”
“C.”
